name: Prism ☆ Magical ~Prism Generations!~
original_name: プリズム☆ ま～じカル PRISM Generations！
source:
This is a comical and heartful magic ‘girl’ battle ADV where everyone, including the protagonist, is a magic girl. A normal boy Raika wishes to live a normal school life in a seaside town Misaki-chou with childhood friend miko Ibuki and his maid Yuri. However, his father was a magic girl and other magic girls are coming to the school to find the hidden magic stone Mana Prism. Because of his lineage, Raika can turn into Crimson Red using the Magical Prism! Now he has to battle other magic girls... who are his allies and who are his enemies!?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是一部滑稽而温馨的魔法“少女”战斗冒险游戏，包括主人公在内的所有人都是魔法少女。普通少年莱华希望与青梅竹马巫女伊吹、女仆百合一起，在海边小镇岬町过着平凡的校园生活。然而，他的父亲曾是魔法少女，其他魔法少女也纷纷来到学校，寻找隐藏的魔法石“Mana Prism”。由于继承了这份血统，莱华能够用Magical Prism变身为Crimson Red！如今，他必须与其他魔法少女战斗…她们之中，谁是伙伴，谁又是敌人！？

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/08/01/august-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
